pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised the operator's policy.

pairs.gold_text: Community support was organized in Withel terraces during community recovery.
pairs.system_text: Community support was organized in Withel terraces for evacuated households.

pairs.gold_text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.
pairs.system_text: The Ashfell bench failure damaged the lower road below Withel.

pairs.gold_text: Damage was reported in Dreth during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Further damage was reported across Dreth, beyond the lower road at Withel.

pairs.gold_text: Service was restored in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals restored the lower road during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Service at the lower road was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Corvane mine is disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service at the Corvane mine was disrupted following the slide.
